note: Hand-written source of the chapter 4 ⚡ stage (Build A pilot, 15 Nov 2026; line 10 and the «percutian» note follow Sam's answers of 17 Nov 2026). tools/build_stretch.py turns it into content/ms/stretch/x04.json: the cards come from the ledger rows placed «Ch4 (extension)» (Malay, meanings, POS, affix tag from the ledger, IDs from its card column); this file adds the notes, frames and dialogue. Malay: Malaysian standard, standard form first, no spoken forms, chapter 4 affix gates (no ber-, meN-, -kan or -i), «dari» for places and times. All Japanese is a draft for the native check.

notes.L-1312: Also in Hanashishou. «Saya beri buku ini.»
notes.L-1321: After the verb: «baca semula» = read again.
notes.L-1342: «Boleh ulang sekali lagi?» = Could you say it once more?
notes.L-1494: «Saya buang.» = I will throw it away.
notes.L-1495: se- + tahun (Ch3) = one year. «setahun sekali» = once a year.
notes.L-1499: malam (Ch1), said twice: late at night.
notes.L-1501: pagi (Ch1), said twice: early in the morning.

L-1502.en: Formal / written: a holiday, a trip. pe-an + cuti (Ch2). In speech, say «cuti»: «cuti tahunan», «pergi bercuti».
L-1502.ja: 書き言葉・改まった言い方（休暇、旅行）。pe-an + cuti（第2課）。話し言葉では «cuti» を使います：«cuti tahunan»（年次休暇）、«pergi bercuti»（休暇に出かける）。

notes.L-1504: Two things at the same time.

frames.example: Saya baca buku itu semula selepas makan malam.
frames.meaning_en: I read that book again after dinner.
frames.meaning_ja: 夕食の後、その本をもう一度読みます。

frames.example: Setahun sekali, keluarga saya datang dari Jepun.
frames.meaning_en: Once a year, my family comes from Japan.
frames.meaning_ja: 年に一度、家族が日本から来ます。

frames.frame: Sekarang sudah hampir pukul ___ dan saya masih ___.
frames.example: Sekarang sudah hampir pukul sebelas malam dan saya masih di pejabat.
frames.meaning_en: It's nearly 11 p.m. and I'm still at the office.
frames.meaning_ja: もうすぐ夜11時ですが、まだ会社にいます。

frames.example: Minggu ini dia kerap balik dari pejabat malam-malam.
frames.meaning_en: This week he often comes home from the office late at night.
frames.meaning_ja: 今週、彼はよく夜遅くに会社から帰ります。

frames.frame: Boleh ___ ulang sekali lagi? Saya belum ___.
frames.example: Boleh Encik ulang sekali lagi? Saya belum faham.
frames.meaning_en: Could you say it once more? I don't understand yet.
frames.meaning_ja: もう一度言っていただけますか。まだわかりません。

frames.example: Esok pagi saya akan beri Encik jadual baru.
frames.meaning_en: Tomorrow morning I'll give you the new schedule.
frames.meaning_ja: 明日の朝、新しい予定表をお渡しします。

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Selamat pagi, Encik Tanaka. Encik datang awal hari ini!
lines.en: Good morning, Mr Tanaka. You're early today!

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Selamat pagi, Puan. Ya, saya bangun pagi-pagi. Mesyuarat mula pukul berapa?
lines.en: Good morning. Yes, I got up early. What time does the meeting start?
choices: Selamat malam, Puan. Saya baru bangun.
Selamat pagi, Puan. Saya datang lambat hari ini.
choices_en: Good evening. I've only just got up.
Good morning. I came late today.

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Pukul sembilan. Sekarang sudah hampir pukul lapan setengah.
lines.en: At nine. It's nearly half past eight now.

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Terima kasih. Boleh Encik cetak jadual ini?
lines.en: Thank you. Could you print this schedule?

lines.speaker: Tanaka
choices_en: Sure. I'll print it next year.
Not yet. I printed it yesterday.

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Encik Rahman datang lambat hari ini. Dia akan sampai pukul sembilan suku.
lines.en: Mr Rahman is coming late today. He'll arrive at a quarter past nine.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.en: Okay, we'll wait for him a moment.

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Ya. Selepas mesyuarat, saya mula cuti tahunan.
lines.en: Yes. After the meeting, my annual leave starts.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.en: Wow, how nice! Where are you going on holiday?
choices: Wah, seronoknya! Puan selalu datang lambat.
choices_en: Wow, how nice! Where's the meeting?
Wow, how nice! You always come late.

lines.speaker: Puan Aini
lines.ms: Di pantai, dengan keluarga saya. Kami pergi setahun sekali.
lines.en: At the beach, with my family. We go once a year.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Sekarang musim hujan. Bawa payung, Puan!
lines.en: It's the rainy season now. Take an umbrella!

lines.speaker: Encik Rahman
lines.ms: Maaf, saya lambat! Jom, kita mula sekarang.
lines.en: Sorry I'm late! Come on, let's start now.

lines.speaker: Tanaka
lines.ms: Baik, Encik. Saya sudah cetak jadual mesyuarat.
lines.en: Okay. I've printed the meeting schedule.
choices: Baik, Encik. Saya akan cetak jadual semalam.
choices_en: Okay. I will print the schedule yesterday.
Okay. I haven't got up yet.
